original_description:
Create Synthesia videos from ChatGPT.

You already write scripts and plan content in ChatGPT. Now the video happens here too. Describe what you need, like a product launch, an explainer or a team update, or paste a script or attach a deck, PDF or image. Synthesia Syren builds the whole video: script, visuals, motion graphics, music and an AI presenter if you want one. If your brief leaves a choice open, Syren asks a quick question.

Watch it appear: your video plays right in the chat. Works in the ChatGPT mobile app too, so you can make and review videos on the go.

Keep it on brand: attach your logo or brand assets, or describe the look you want, and Syren uses them to style your video.

Fix it by asking: "tighten the intro", "make it moodier", "swap the second scene", and Syren updates the same video.

Share it: publish to a Share page and get a link anyone can watch, or export an MP4.

Make it part of your workflow. Turn notes from a sales call into a 60-second recap, this week's updates into a Friday video for the team, or a release's changelog into a launch explainer. Anything already in the chat can go into your video, including results from your other ChatGPT apps.

Syren is in beta, makes videos up to 3 minutes long and uses your Synthesia credits. Want a classic Synthesia video with your template or brand kit? Just ask. Requires a Synthesia account.
summary_ja: 文章・資料から映像、音楽、必要に応じてAIプレゼンターを含む動画を作成し、会話で修正・MP4出力する。
limitations: Syrenはベータ版で最大3分、Synthesiaのクレジットを消費すると説明。アプリ欄は有料アカウントが必要と記載。
共有ページはリンクを知る人が閲覧できると説明。
料金・実動作・一覧本体との名称照合は未確認。
